Players Committee card image of [[Coruscant: Night Club (ALT)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “'''Light Side:''' Your characters here are defense value -1 and may not be excluded from battle.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/coruscantnightclub_ai.png</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e1a6ab973f90c7e27c46017e1cc0b6183821519d e1a6ab9] (18 February 2021). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
